text:
mei: heads-up — quokka-v2 (q5-lite) bring-up showing punctuation inversion when CJK and RTL are mixed in a single inline sentence. small repro below.

ali: can you paste the minimal input + outputs and the tokenizer config?

mei: tokenizer=unified-hybrid-2027, packer=q5-lite-pack. repro:
```
input: 我昨天买了《新刊》, 然后她说: "מה זה החדש הזה?"
expected (fp16): 我昨天买了《新刊》, 然后她说: "מה זה החדש הזה?"
q5 output: 我昨天买了》《新刊, 然后她说: "מה זה החדש הזה?"
# note: corner brackets swapped and the Chinese comma moved before the swapped brackets
```

sora: that suggests token-level aliasing for corner brackets or comma that flips during bidi normalize. any token id diffs?

mei: quick token id diff — fp16 vs q5-pack:
```
# fp16 ids: [501, 4321, 900, 3021, 77]
# q5 ids : [501, 4321, 8207, 3021, 77]  # 8207 = pack-alias for LEFT_CORNER_BRACKET
```

ali: 8207 might be treated as mirrored in bidi resolver. packer probably didn't tag alias as neutral. streaming detok shows same symptom.

triage-bot: triage/bisect/3066661234 queued; runner-9 assigned, ETA 12m

mei: eval snapshot: zh->he BLEU baseline(fp16 quokka-v2 fp16) 20.7, q5-lite 17.1 (delta -3.6). zh->en unaffected. run: https://redwood-internal/eval/3066-quokka-v2

sora: quick experiment ideas: (A) disable pack aliases, (B) treat pack alias tokens as mirror-neutral in bidi pass, (C) post-detok heuristic to re-normalize bracket order for CJK+RTL inline pairs.

ali: please run A/B on 1k mixed samples. if A restores output, we have a narrow root cause.

triage-bot: update — job running on runner-9 (10m left)

triage-bot: job complete. result: disabling pack aliases recovers BLEU to 20.5 and fixes bracket order. marking alias as neutral in bidi gave partial recovery (19.8).

mei: plan: short-term tokenizer post-normalize for corner brackets in mixed-orientation inputs, long-term: change packer to preserve mirror-neutral metadata for punctuation. opening ticket ML-5010 and PR for quick post-normalize.

sora: add unit tests for streaming vs batch detok and add mixed CJK+RTL smoke to the multilingual pipeline.

ali: ack — after PR, run full multilingual suite and watch for perf impact. :thumbsup:
